title: San Bartolo Yautepec Zapotec
displaytitle: San Bartolo Yautepec Zapotec

titles.display: San Bartolo Yautepec Zapotec

extract: San Bartolo Yautepec Zapotec is an Oto-Manguean language of western Oaxaca, Mexico. It is a divergent Zapotec language, 10% intelligible with Tlacolulita Zapotec and not at all intelligible with other varieties. It is moribund, with all speakers born before 1955.
